svg.title: Red Curve VII
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. White seen beside the shaped red canvas is wall, and remains transparent. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.christies.com/en/lot/lot-6236039; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable study, not a facsimile.
